title: Craigdarroch Castle
scope: The standing Craigdarroch Castle masonry mansion in Victoria, including the round tower, open carriage porch, steep slate roof, dormers and attached bays.
limitations: Small carving, decorative ironwork and areas away from the documented elevation are approximated. The tallest finial is narrower than the survey grid and is estimated.
The model is the exterior of the mansion. The interior, grounds and outbuildings are outside the model scope.
